products.title: 100 Quart Patio Cooler - Acacia
products.description:
A rolling beverage cooler from Backyard Discovery that holds 100 quarts, built on an acacia wood frame. Acacia is naturally water-resistant, which is what makes the cart suitable for staying out in all weather. The top is a solid block surface for drink and food prep, and the casters lock so the cart stays where you put it.
Inside is an FDA-approved insulated liner rated for eight-hour ice retention. That liner is soft and removable, with a drain built in, so cleaning up does not mean tipping the whole cart over. The lid runs on air shock hinges and opens easily instead of dropping shut.
Towel racks and a bottle opener are attached to the frame, and a waterproof cover comes with it for the stretch of the year the cart is not in use.
products.excerpt: Backyard Discovery's 100-quart cooler cart rolls on locking casters, holds ice for eight hours in an FDA-approved liner, and ships with a waterproof cover.

products.description:

products.title: Mosquito Netting Kit-Arcadia Gazebos
products.description:
This kit is a set of fiberglass mesh panels cut specifically for the Backyard Discovery Arcadia gazebo. The panels hang from the exterior posts rather than inside them, so screening the gazebo does not cost you any of the floor space you already have.
Each panel glides on an easy-install track and closes with heavy-duty zippers. Post ties hold the panels back against the frame when you would rather have the gazebo open. A pocket runs along the bottom of each panel and takes sand or weights, which keeps the netting down on breezy days. The fiberglass mesh keeps insects out while staying open to airflow and clear enough to see through. Backyard Discovery covers the kit with a 5-year warranty.
products.excerpt: Fiberglass mesh netting cut for the Backyard Discovery Arcadia gazebo, hung outside the posts on glide tracks with zippered panels and post ties.

products.title: Mosquito Netting Kit-Arlington Gazebos
products.description:
Double-sided zippers are the detail that matters most here, since they let you open a panel from inside the Arlington gazebo or from the yard without walking around to the other side. The panels are fiberglass mesh, sized for the Arlington and hung outside the gazebo posts so the interior stays fully usable.
Smooth-glide tracks install onto the frame and let the panels move without dragging. Post ties secure them out of the way when you want the gazebo open, and built-in pockets at the bottom of each panel take sand or weights to hold the netting steady in wind. The mesh keeps views clear and air moving, and the kit carries a 5-year warranty.
products.excerpt: Fiberglass mesh panels sized for the Arlington gazebo, with double-sided zippers, smooth-glide tracks, post ties and weight pockets along the hem.

products.title: Mosquito Netting Kit-Barrington Gazebos
products.description:
Screening a gazebo usually costs you space along the inside edge. These panels mount outside the Barrington's posts instead, so the interior stays exactly as big as it was.
The mesh is fiberglass, chosen to hold up outdoors while staying clear enough to see through and open enough to let air move. Panels run on easy-install tracks and close with heavy-duty zippers built for daily use, and post-mounted ties hold them back for open-air evenings. Pockets at the bottom of each panel take sand weights so the netting stays put when the wind picks up. The kit fits Barrington gazebos and is backed by a 5-year warranty.
products.excerpt: Mesh netting made for Barrington gazebos: fiberglass panels on glide tracks, heavy-duty zippers, post ties and sand pockets, under a 5-year warranty.

Eight feet wide and six feet tall, this panel blocks sightlines on a deck, a balcony, or along a garden path without sealing off the air. The screen pairs cedar panels with aluminum posts, and the wooden panels allow natural airflow while the aluminum keeps the panel stable through any weather.
It works as a divider beside a hot tub, a dining table, or anywhere a full fence would be too much. The design is modular, and the separate Privacy Wall Add-On Kit extends it into a longer run or turns it around a corner. It ships ready to assemble.

products.title: Rockport Steel Grill Gazebo
products.description:
Every part of the Rockport is powder-coated galvanized steel: the rust-resistant frame, the solid walls, and the two bar countertops that flank the grill bay. There is no wood to seal or restain, and the black finish keeps its look outdoors season after season.
The bay takes most grills up to 70 inches wide, and four magnetic hooks stick anywhere on the steel walls for tongs, brushes, and mitts. The patented PowerPort™ built into the structure supplies three electrical outlets and three USB ports for a blender, lighting, or music. Backyard Discovery's Pro-Tect™ testing rates the roof to loads of up to 2,000 pounds and the structure to wind speeds up to 100 mph.
products.excerpt: An all-steel grill gazebo with solid walls, two bar countertops, and a PowerPort, Pro-Tect rated to 2,000 pounds of roof load and 100 mph winds.

products.title: Rockport XL Steel Grill Gazebo
products.description:
The XL widens the Rockport's bay enough to hold more than one cooker, so a grill, a smoker, and a griddle can sit side by side instead of taking turns. Six magnetic accessory hooks come with it, and they attach anywhere on the steel walls.
Construction is powder-coated galvanized steel throughout, including the rust-resistant frame, the solid walls, and two steel bar countertops for prep and serving. The patented PowerPort™ provides three electrical outlets and three USB ports. Pro-Tect™ testing rates the larger roof to loads of up to 3,800 pounds and the structure to winds up to 100 mph. The black powder-coated finish needs no annual maintenance.
products.excerpt: The XL Rockport holds multiple grills, smokers, or griddles under one steel roof, Pro-Tect rated to 3,800 pounds of load and 100 mph wind speeds.

products.title: Rosewood Falls Swing Set
products.description:
A raised clubhouse anchors the Rosewood Falls, with a peak roof, bay windows, and a crow's nest above it where a toy telescope is mounted. A wave slide runs down from the clubhouse deck, a rock wall gives kids a way back up, and monkey bars span the frame for crossing hand over hand.
Underneath the clubhouse, a lower-level playhouse holds a play kitchen with a toy stovetop, sink, and cookware set, along with a working half-door and a mounted chalkboard. The swing beam carries two classic belt swings and a web disc swing. The set is built from cedar in a light brown stain and arrives ready to assemble, with guided instructions in the BILT® app.
products.excerpt: A cedar swing set with a raised clubhouse, wave slide, rock wall, monkey bars, three swings, and a lower-level playhouse fitted with a toy kitchen.

products.title: Rustic Roots Chicken Coop
products.description:
Sized for a flock of up to six hens, this raised coop sits above a 48 sq. ft. run that extends underneath the housing, giving the birds ground to scratch and forage without a separate enclosure. A solar-powered door opens and closes on a timer you set, shutting them in at night and letting them out on schedule each morning.
Eggs are collected from outside through a side-access door that opens onto all four holes of the nesting box. Three 50-inch roosting bars provide more than 12 linear feet of perch space for the night. The front door latches securely and opens the interior up for cleaning, and the rubber floor pads lift out. The structure is cedar in a warm brown stain under a powder-coated galvanized steel roof.
products.excerpt: A raised cedar coop for up to six hens with a 48 sq. ft. run underneath, a solar-powered timer door, and a four-hole nesting box reached from outside.

It tucks into an angle of a room where a rectangular cabin would not fit, and the L-shaped bench inside seats four or leaves one person space to recline. Eleven low-EMF far infrared carbon panels line the angled interior and reach your set temperature about 20% faster.
The walls are cedar, 33% thicker than standard panels and built double-wall, with an 8mm tempered glass door. Red light therapy, chromotherapy, Bluetooth speakers, and the controls are all standard. products.title: Scenic Heights Wooden Playhouse
products.description:
The Scenic Heights is an elevated cedar playhouse from Backyard Discovery with two ways in. One entrance runs through saloon doors reached by a flat step entry ladder, the other through a side porch with a sturdy wooden staircase. Inside, a play kitchen with a toy sink and stove top gives kids somewhere to cook up pretend meals, and a cushioned bench sits along one wall with toy storage drawers underneath it.
A growth chart is built in, so heights get recorded in the playhouse rather than on a doorframe indoors. Raising the floor off the ground gives the whole thing more of a treehouse feel than a garden cottage, and the cedar is chosen to hold up outdoors over years of use.

products.title: Stratford | 12x10 Steel Pergola – Black
products.description:
The Stratford is a traditional steel pergola in a 12x10 footprint. The proportions follow traditional architecture, and the posts, beams, and rafters are sized so the structure carries visual weight instead of reading as a light frame.
Construction is fully powder-coated galvanized steel in black, with material up to 30% thicker than typical mass-produced options and part profiles three times larger than standard small-footprint kits. Components are tested for long-term durability, including performance in high winds and coastal environments.
products.excerpt: The 12x10 Stratford is a black powder-coated galvanized steel pergola with traditional proportions and steel up to 30% thicker than mass-produced kits.

products.title: Stratford | 12x10 Steel Pergola – White
products.description:
White powder coating over galvanized steel gives this 12x10 Stratford a lighter presence than the black version, closer to painted millwork than to metal. The traditional proportions carry through the posts, beams, and rafters, which are cut heavier than the parts in a typical kit.
Range specifies steel up to 30% thicker than typical mass-produced options and part profiles three times larger than standard small-footprint kits, and every component is tested for long-term durability in demanding conditions such as high winds and coastal environments. At 12x10 the footprint suits a patio, a seating group, or the stretch of ground directly outside a set of back doors.
products.excerpt: A white powder-coated steel pergola in the 12x10 size, built from galvanized steel with part profiles three times larger than small-footprint kits.

products.title: Stratford | 14x10 Steel Pergola – Black
products.description:
Stretching to 14x10 gives this Stratford a longer run of rafters than the 12x10, which suits a patio that sits wide against the back of a house. Traditional architectural proportions govern the post, beam, and rafter sizes, so the frame holds its shape visually rather than disappearing overhead.
The structure is fully powder-coated galvanized steel. Range uses material up to 30% thicker than typical mass-produced options, with part profiles three times larger than standard small-footprint kits, and puts components through testing for long-term durability under high winds and coastal conditions. In black, the rafters cast a strong pattern of shadow across a deck through the afternoon.
products.excerpt: The 14x10 Stratford stretches a black steel pergola along one wall, built from powder-coated galvanized steel and tested for high winds and coastal air.

products.title: Stratford | 14x10 Steel Pergola – White
products.description:
Galvanized steel under a full powder coat is what holds the 14x10 Stratford together, and the white finish keeps that structure from feeling heavy overhead. Posts, beams, and rafters are proportioned after traditional architecture rather than scaled down to save on shipping weight.
The material runs up to 30% thicker than typical mass-produced options, and the part profiles are three times larger than those in standard small-footprint kits. Each component is tested for long-term durability and reliable performance in harsh conditions, high winds and coastal environments included. The 14x10 footprint covers a long table or a seating arrangement with room to walk around the edges.
products.excerpt: A 14x10 pergola in white powder-coated galvanized steel, with traditional proportions and components tested for high wind and coastal conditions.

products.title: Stratford | 14x12 Steel Pergola – Black
products.description:
Weather is the test a permanent outdoor structure has to pass, and the Stratford is engineered for it. Every component is checked for long-term durability and reliable performance in harsh conditions, high winds and coastal environments among them, and the frame is fully powder-coated galvanized steel throughout.
At 14x12 this one covers enough ground for a dining table and a separate seating area underneath the same roofline. The material is up to 30% thicker than typical mass-produced options, with part profiles three times larger than standard small-footprint kits, and the posts, beams, and rafters follow traditional architectural proportions. Black powder coating finishes it.
products.excerpt: Built for wind and coastal exposure, this 14x12 black Stratford uses powder-coated galvanized steel up to 30% thicker than mass-produced pergola kits.

products.title: Stratford | 14x12 Steel Pergola – White
products.description:
Fourteen by twelve is the size at which a pergola stops shading a table and starts defining an outdoor room. This Stratford covers that span in fully powder-coated galvanized steel finished in white, with posts, beams, and rafters proportioned after traditional architecture.
Range builds the frame from material up to 30% thicker than typical mass-produced options and uses part profiles three times larger than standard small-footprint kits, then tests components for long-term durability in demanding conditions including high winds and coastal environments. The white finish reflects rather than absorbs light, which keeps the space underneath from reading as dim on a bright day.
products.excerpt: At 14x12 this white Stratford covers a dining area and seating together, framed in powder-coated galvanized steel with oversized posts, beams, and rafters.

products.title: Stratford | 16x12 Steel Pergola – Black
products.description:
Part size is what separates the Stratford from a flat-pack pergola, and it shows most at 16x12. The profiles are three times larger than those used in standard small-footprint kits, and the steel itself runs up to 30% thicker than typical mass-produced options, so a span this wide keeps the proportions of traditional architecture instead of thinning out.
The frame is galvanized steel under a full powder coat in black. Components are tested for long-term durability and reliable performance in harsh conditions, including high winds and coastal environments.
products.excerpt: This 16x12 black pergola uses steel part profiles three times larger than standard small-footprint kits, on a fully powder-coated galvanized frame.

products.title: Stratford | 16x12 Steel Pergola – White
products.description:
A pergola this size changes how a house meets its yard, and the Stratford is designed to read as an extension of the building rather than an object dropped into the garden. The 16x12 span in white powder-coated galvanized steel makes a clean transition from indoor rooms to outdoor ones.
Posts, beams, and rafters follow traditional architectural proportions and are cut from material up to 30% thicker than typical mass-produced options, with part profiles three times larger than standard small-footprint kits. Testing covers long-term durability and reliable performance in harsh conditions, high winds and coastal environments included.
products.excerpt: A 16x12 white steel pergola that extends the house outward, built from powder-coated galvanized steel and tested against high wind and coastal exposure.

products.title: Sweetwater Chicken Coop
products.description:
Four to six chickens fit in the Sweetwater, an elevated cedar coop whose 24 sq. ft. run extends underneath the raised floor so the footprint does double duty. Birds get room to scratch and move without taking up more of the yard.
A solar-powered door opens and closes on a timer you set, which shuts the flock in against predators overnight and lets them out in the morning without anyone walking outside. Nesting boxes give hens a quiet place to lay and keep egg collection simple. Roosting bars inside give them a natural perch after dark. Windows bring daylight into the coop and the full front door locks, opening wide for cleaning and daily care. The finish is cedar in a modern white stain under a black galvanized steel roof.
products.excerpt: An elevated cedar coop for four to six chickens with a 24 sq. ft. run underneath, a solar timer door, nesting boxes, roosting bars, and a steel roof.

products.title: Sweetwater Chicken Coop - Brown
products.description:
Brown-stained cedar and a powder-coated galvanized steel roof give this Sweetwater its farmhouse look, but the details inside are what make it workable day to day. It houses four to six chickens, with a 24 sq. ft. run extending under the elevated coop.
The two-hole nesting box gives hens separate, quiet spaces to lay, and a side-access door opens for full visibility into both boxes at collection time. Two interior roosting bars provide 4.5 linear feet of perch, enough for birds to spread out overnight. A solar-powered door opens and closes on a timer you set, closing the flock in against predators at night and letting them out on schedule each morning. Windows let natural light in, and the full front door locks and opens wide for cleaning.
products.excerpt: Brown cedar Sweetwater coop for four to six birds, with a 24 sq. ft. run, a two-hole nesting box, 4.5 feet of roost, and a solar door on a timer.

products.title: Sweetwater Heights Elevated Playhouse
products.description:
Sweetwater Heights sits up on a raised deck that wraps around the playhouse, which is what separates it from a ground-level house of similar size. Kids climb the wide step ladder, built with wide-rung steps that suit a range of ages, and take the wave slide back down.
Inside, the play kitchen has a toy stovetop, a built-in sink, battery-powered appliances, and other accessories. A working door and large windows bring in sunlight and fresh air while leaving you a clear view of what is happening from the yard. A measurement board is attached for tracking how much everyone has grown. The space beneath the deck can hold a sandbox or serve as toy storage. Cedar construction in neutral colors keeps the footprint modest for smaller yards.
products.excerpt: An elevated cedar playhouse with a wrap-around deck, wave slide, play kitchen with battery-powered appliances, growth board, and open storage space below.

products.title: Sweetwater Playhouse
products.description:
The Sweetwater Playhouse is cedar, finished light brown with black trim. A working half door makes the entrance, large windows let in light and moving air, and the snack bar window turns the place into a cafe or a tea party depending on the game being played that afternoon.
Inside are a toy sink, a stove, a cordless phone, and an assortment of other accessories to work with. Flowerpot holders on the exterior give young gardeners somewhere to put their pots. The pieces arrive pre-cut, pre-stained, and pre-drilled, so putting it together is mostly a matter of working through the sequence in order.
products.excerpt: A cedar playhouse with a working half door, snack bar window, toy kitchen accessories, and flowerpot holders, shipping pre-cut, pre-stained and pre-drilled.

products.title: Sweetwater Playhouse - White
products.description:
Cedar construction finished in white with black trim gives the Sweetwater Playhouse the look of a cottage. Backyard Discovery fits it with large windows that keep the interior bright and let a breeze move through on warm days. Decorative flowerpot holders sit on the outside for children who want to plant something, and a working half door gives them an entrance of their own. A snack bar window is where most of the pretend cafe and tea party business ends up happening.
Inside there is a toy sink, a stove, a cordless phone, and a range of other play accessories. Pieces arrive pre-cut, pre-stained, and pre-drilled, so putting it together is a matter of following the sequence rather than cutting and finishing lumber yourself.
products.excerpt: A cedar playhouse in white with black trim, with a working half door, snack bar window, flowerpot holders, and a toy sink, stove, and phone inside.

products.title: Tacoma Falls Swing Set
products.description:
Tacoma Falls stacks two separate play spaces into one structure. The upper clubhouse has windows, a wooden roof, and a built-in chalkboard, with a crow's nest lookout and toy telescope above it. Two slides run down from that level, an enclosed spiral tube slide that twists on the way and a wave slide for a faster straight shot. A rock wall and a step ladder give kids two ways back up.
The lower playhouse has its own full front door and a play kitchen behind it, with a toy sink, a cookware set, a dinner bell, and battery-powered accessories. Two belt swings and a web disc swing hang alongside the structure.
Backyard Discovery builds the set from natural cedar and ships it ready to assemble, with guided instructions in the BILT app. It carries a 5-year warranty.
products.excerpt: A two-level cedar playset with an upper clubhouse, a lower play kitchen, spiral tube and wave slides, two belt swings, and a web disc swing.
highlights: Lower Playhouse: Includes a play kitchen with a toy sink, battery powered accessories, cookware set, dinner bell, and full front door to inspire creativity
Industry-Leading Warranty: 5-year warranty for added peace of mind
Spiral Tube Slide: Enclosed curvy slide delivers exhilarating, twisty rides for little adventurers
Crow’s Nest: Elevated lookout with toy telescope inspires imaginative exploration and adventurous quests

products.title: Tanglewood Swing Set
products.description:
The Tanglewood works on two levels. Up top is a clubhouse with a peak roof and a mini porch, reached by a rock wall ladder whose six holds double as steps for kids who want the simpler route. An 8-foot wave slide runs back down to the ground from there.
Beneath the clubhouse sits a playhouse with white-trimmed windows and a snack bar window under a small wooden roof, with built-in wooden bench seating underneath it for snack breaks and quieter play. Two classic belt swings and a trapeze bar give three places to swing at once.
The set is built from cedar and arrives ready to assemble, with step-by-step guidance in the BILT app. Backyard Discovery covers it with a 5-year warranty.
products.excerpt: A cedar playset from Backyard Discovery with a peak-roof clubhouse, snack bar bench seating, an 8-foot wave slide, two belt swings, and a trapeze.
highlights: Lower Playhouse: Charming play space featuring windows with white trim adds a realistic touch to inspire creativity
Industry-Leading Warranty: 5-year warranty for added peace of mind
Snack Bar Station: Covered snack counter with bench seating creates a cozy café setting, ideal for enjoying snacks and imaginative play
Versatile Swinging Fun: 2 classic belt swings and 1 trapeze allow multiple kids to swing at once

products.title: Timber Crossing Swing Set
products.description:
A connecting bridge is what sets the Timber Crossing apart, running out from the elevated play area to a rock wall attached at its far end. The upper clubhouse has a wood roof, a balcony, and wide windows that keep the space open and light. A second climbing wall with a rope assist goes up the back of the clubhouse, and a flat wide step ladder gives younger kids a straightforward way up.
Coming down is an 8-foot wave slide. Swinging happens on two belt swings, a trapeze bar, and a large web disc swing wide enough for more than one child.
The wood is natural cedar in a light brown stain with black trim. Backyard Discovery ships the set ready to assemble with guided instructions in the BILT app and backs it with a 5-year warranty.
products.excerpt: Cedar playset with a bridge to a climbing wall, a balconied clubhouse, an 8-foot wave slide, two belt swings, a trapeze, and a web disc swing.

products.title: Timber Rock Outdoor Argentine Grill Cook Station
products.description:
Argentine grilling over an open fire is what the Timber Rock cook station is built around. Adjustable stainless steel grates and S-hooks let you raise, lower, or hang different cuts depending on how fast you want them to cook, and the open-fire design leaves a large working surface for slow roasting. Firebrick and ceramic-lined walls behind powder-coated steel hold heat steady through a long cook.
The station is solid cedar and powder-coated galvanized steel, chosen to resist rust, dents, and corrosion outdoors. Quartz countertops give you room to prep and plate, and drawers plus open storage below keep wood, tools, and accessories in order. The cantilever roof uses Pro-Tect tested construction rated to withstand up to 2,150 pounds of snow load and 100 mph winds.
It ships ready to assemble with step-by-step BILT instructions.
products.excerpt: A cedar and powder-coated steel cook station with a firebrick-lined Argentine grill, adjustable steel grates and S-hooks, and quartz countertops.

products.title: Timberlake Playhouse
products.description:
Wide windows on the Timberlake let daylight and moving air into an interior with room for more than one child at a time. Backyard Discovery finishes the outside with flowerpot holders and a working half door, and a snack bar window opens onto a counter for serving up whatever is on the pretend menu.
Inside there is a play sink, a toy stove, and a cordless phone. The playhouse is built from durable cedar, sized for solo play or a group of friends, and it arrives ready to assemble.
products.excerpt: A cedar playhouse with wide windows, flowerpot holders, a working half door, a snack bar window, and a play sink, toy stove, and cordless phone.

products.title: Tucson Swing Set
products.description:
Shade is designed into the Tucson at both levels. The raised deck sits under a brightly colored canopy roof, and the play space beneath the deck stays in the shadow of it, with a snack bar window and built-in bench seating along one side for juice breaks or drawing. That lower area can be filled with sand to make a sandbox, though sand is not included.
Kids reach the deck by a rock wall with six holds that also works as a ladder, then take the 8-foot wave slide back down. Two belt swings and a trapeze bar round out the active play.
The cedar carries a burnt sienna finish, and pieces come pre-cut, pre-drilled, and pre-stained with guided setup in the BILT app. Backyard Discovery covers the set for 5 years.
products.excerpt: A burnt sienna cedar swing set with a canopy-shaded deck, sandbox space, snack bar seating, an 8-foot wave slide, two belt swings, and a trapeze.
highlights: Lower Play Space: Shaded sandbox area to inspire creative sensory play (sand not included)
Industry-Leading Warranty: 5-year warranty for added peace of mind
Built-In Picnic Area: Covered snack bar window with bench seating is ideal for juice breaks or arts and crafts
Versatile Swinging Fun: 2 classic belt swings and 1 trapeze allow multiple kids to swing at once

products.title: Tuscany Corner Pergola with Conversation Seating - Privacy Panels
products.description:
The Tuscany is a corner pergola with the seating built into it, so it sits along the edge of a patio instead of occupying the middle of it. Two oversized sofas anchor to a powder-coated steel base that ties directly into the cedar posts, which means the furniture and the frame hold together as one piece rather than sitting loose underneath. A fixed Meranti wood table goes between them, and the arrangement seats four to six.
Framing is cedar throughout, substantial enough to give the structure real weight on a patio, and cedar holds up to year-round weather without rotting or decaying. The slat roof filters direct sun into shade, while composite privacy panels along the back walls screen the seating from neighbors and leave the open sides uncovered.
It comes ready to assemble, with a 5-year warranty covering every component.
products.excerpt: A cedar corner pergola with two built-in sofas on a steel base, a fixed Meranti table, a slat roof, and composite privacy panels along the back.

products.title: Verona Corner Pergola
products.description:
Verona is a corner pergola, shaped to tuck into the angle of a yard, patio, or deck and turn that corner into a defined, sheltered spot. Construction is 100 percent cedar and heavy-duty rather than lightweight, with composite panels that supply both shade and seclusion. The finish is a light brown stain.
Because it encloses a corner rather than standing free in the open, it suits a fire pit enclosure or a quiet reading nook equally well, and it works poolside or in a garden corner.
Materials arrive pre-cut, pre-drilled, and pre-stained, and the BILT app walks through assembly step by step. Backyard Discovery backs the pergola with a 5-year warranty.
products.excerpt: A heavy-duty all-cedar corner pergola with composite panels for shade and seclusion, a light brown stain, and a 5-year Backyard Discovery warranty.

products.title: Voyager Swing Set
products.description:
Several routes lead up to the Voyager's clubhouse. Kids can swing across the monkey bars, scale a rock wall with 12 holds, or take the flat-step ladder with handles. The clubhouse at the top is large, with a covered entryway, a balcony, windows, and a peaked roof, and a 10-foot wave slide brings riders back to the ground.
The space under the deck is left open on purpose. It holds sand for digging, takes a blanket for a picnic, or becomes a play cafe through the attached snack bar window. Two belt swings and a trapeze hang alongside.
Construction is all cedar, which naturally resists warping, decay, and insect damage. The set is designed for up to 11 kids and engineered to meet or exceed ASTM F1148-22, for residential use only. The pre-stained warm light brown finish varies in saturation and color. It ships ready to assemble with guided BILT instructions and a 5-year warranty.
products.excerpt: An all-cedar playset with monkey bars, a 12-hold rock wall, a 10-foot wave slide, a sandbox space beneath the deck, and room for up to 11 kids.
highlights: Lower Play Space: Includes a shaded lower sandbox area to inspire creative sensory play (sand not included)
Industry-Leading Warranty: 5-year warranty for added peace of mind
Monkey Bar Fun: Creates a playful challenge that promotes strength as children swing and climb
Snack Bar Window: Spacious side window is perfect for serving up juice boxes and break-time treats

products.title: Wave Slide - 10 foot
products.description:
A ten-foot wave slide from Backyard Discovery, the wave being the dip and rise along its length rather than a straight drop.
It is sold on its own, which makes it a replacement for a slide that has worn out or a way to add one to a structure that can take it. No frame or hardware for building a tower comes with it. Home24Care lists it alongside the gray and yellow versions of the same slide.
products.excerpt: A ten-foot wave slide from Backyard Discovery, sold on its own as a replacement or an addition to a play set you already have.

products.title: Whispering Point Swing Set
products.description:
Bay windows give the Whispering Point's upper clubhouse more character than a plain walled box, and a crow's nest lookout above it comes with a toy telescope. The play kitchen on the lower level is well stocked, with a toy stovetop, a sink and faucet, a battery-powered blender, and a cookware set.
Climbing routes include a rock wall and a rope climbing wall, with a step ladder for children not ready for either. Two belt swings and a web disc swing handle the swinging, and an 8-foot wave slide runs down from the clubhouse.
The structure is cedar. It arrives ready to assemble with guided instructions in the BILT app, and Backyard Discovery covers it with a 5-year warranty.
products.excerpt: A cedar playset with a bay-window clubhouse, a crow's nest telescope, a stocked play kitchen, rock and rope climbing walls, and an 8-foot wave slide.
highlights: Lower Playhouse: Includes a play kitchen with a toy stovetop, sink, battery powered blender, and cookware set to inspire creativity
Industry-Leading Warranty: 5-year warranty for added peace of mind
Crow’s Nest: Elevated lookout with a toy telescope inspires imaginative exploration and adventurous quests
Web Disc Swing: Engaging web disc offers ultimate fun, perfect for swinging and soaring

products.title: Woodland Swing Set
products.description:
An octagonal play space sits beneath the Woodland's clubhouse, with a half door opening onto a snack bar serving station and three built-in seats around it. The clubhouse above has a peak roof and diamond-shaped peepholes, which is where the forest cottage look comes from.
Two ways lead up to it, a rock wall for kids who want the climb and a flat step ladder for those who do not. The 10-foot wave slide is the way back down. Two classic belt swings and a trapeze bar sit alongside for swinging and gymnastic-style play.
Cedar gives the set its strength and its weather resistance. It ships ready to assemble with guided instructions in the BILT app from Backyard Discovery.
products.excerpt: A cedar playset with a peephole clubhouse, an octagonal snack bar space with three seats, a 10-foot wave slide, two belt swings, and a trapeze.

products.title: Woodridge Elite Swing Set
products.description:
A tunnel runs between play levels on the Woodridge Elite, ending at a crow's nest lookout. The clubhouse it connects has a wooden roof and windows, and a wrap-around porch breaks the upper level into several distinct areas rather than one flat platform, including a lean-to that opens onto the 10-foot wave slide.
The rock wall is extra tall and doubles as a ladder, so climbing up and walking up are both options. Down below, the lower play area has a shaded wooden deck with a built-in bench, plus adjacent ground suited to a sandbox. Two classic belt swings and a trapeze bar hang alongside.
The set is built from naturally durable cedar. It arrives ready to assemble, with guided instructions in the Backyard Discovery BILT app.
products.excerpt: A cedar playset with a tunnel to a crow's nest, a wrap-around porch, an extra-tall rock wall, a 10-foot wave slide, two belt swings, and a trapeze.

products.title: Yellow Wave Slide - 10 foot
products.description: A 10-foot wave slide in yellow, made by Backyard Discovery for use on a swing set. The wave shape gives a rolling ride down rather than a straight drop, and the high side walls keep the rider in place through it. One-piece construction means there are no sections to join during installation. It is designed to hold 250 pounds.
products.excerpt: A 10-foot yellow wave slide from Backyard Discovery, of one-piece construction with high side walls and designed to hold a rider up to 250 pounds.
